correctness.rationale: For composite n>=4 write x=psi(n)-n, y=sigma(n)-psi(n). The prime-factor Euler products prove phi+psi>=2n; multiplicativity gives y>=0, equality exactly for squarefree n. For squarefree composites n>=6 and x>=6, G(n,x,0)=(x-1)(3n^2+9nx+9n+x^2+x+1)>=2645. For nonsquarefree n>=4, x>=2,y>=1, the explicit cubic G is strictly increasing in n,x,y on that region and G(4,2,1)=290. Direct phi(4)=2,psi(4)=6,sigma(4)=7 gives defect 290 and uniquely n=4. Independent exact factoring/regression checked 1,696 composite integers but is not the all-n proof.
